description_en: Modifies the configuration of a specified scheduled virus scan policy. The Whitelist parameter performs a full overwrite, meaning the provided list replaces the existing exception user list of the policy
description_zh: 修改指定病毒定时扫描策略的配置。其中Whitelist为全量覆盖，传入的名单会替换该策略原有的例外用户名单
name: UpdateVirusScanScheduledStrategy

parameters.help_en: The policy name. The name can be up to 128 characters in length and can contain Chinese characters, uppercase and lowercase letters, digits, periods (.), underscores (_), and hyphens (-). Spaces are not supported
parameters.help_zh: 策略名称。长度不超过128个字符，支持中文、大小写英文字母、数字及半角句点（.）、下划线（_）、连字符（-），不支持空格
parameters.name: strategy_name

parameters.example: 每周日凌晨对研发部门终端全盘扫描
parameters.help_en: The policy description. The description can contain Chinese characters, uppercase and lowercase letters, digits, spaces, periods (.), commas (,), semicolons (;), forward slashes (/), at signs (@), hyphens (-), and underscores (_)
parameters.help_zh: 策略描述。支持中文、大小写英文字母、数字及空格、半角句点（.）、逗号（,）、分号（;）、正斜杠（/）、@、连字符（-）、下划线（_）
parameters.name: strategy_description

parameters.help_en: The policy priority. A smaller value indicates a higher priority. Valid values: 1 to 100
parameters.help_zh: 策略优先级，数值越小优先级越高。取值范围：1~100
parameters.name: priority

parameters.help_en:
The enabled status. Valid values:
Enabled: Enabled.
Disabled: Disabled.

When enabled, the policy immediately participates in periodic scheduling. When disabled, the policy is saved but does not trigger scans
parameters.help_zh:
启用状态。取值：
Enabled：已启用。
Disabled：已停用。
启用后策略立即参与周期调度；停用时策略仅保存，不触发扫描
parameters.name: status

parameters.help_en: The collection of virus types to be handled in this scan. At least one type must be specified, and duplicates are not allowed
parameters.help_zh: 本次扫描要处置的病毒类型集合，至少包含1个，不允许重复
parameters.name: scan_targets

parameters.help_en:
The path scope for scanning. Valid values:
Quick: Quick scan. Only system-critical directories and common risk locations are scanned.
Full: Full disk scan.
Custom: Custom path scan. ScanPath is required when this value is specified
parameters.help_zh:
扫描的路径范围。取值：
Quick：快速扫描，仅扫描系统关键目录与常见风险位置。
Full：全盘扫描。
Custom：自定义路径扫描，此时ScanPath必填
parameters.name: scan_mode

parameters.help_en: The collection of custom scan paths. A maximum of 100 paths can be specified, and duplicates are not allowed. This parameter takes effect only when ScanMode is set to Custom
parameters.help_zh: 自定义扫描路径集合。最多包含100个，不允许重复。仅在ScanMode为Custom时生效
parameters.name: scan_path

parameters.help_en:
The scan performance pattern. Valid values:
SecurityFirst: Security first. The default CPU usage limit is 50%.
Balance: Balanced. The default CPU usage limit is 30%.
ExperienceFirst: Experience first. The default CPU usage limit is 15%
parameters.help_zh:
扫描性能模式。取值：
SecurityFirst：安全优先，CPU占用上限默认为50%。
Balance：均衡，CPU占用上限默认为30%。
ExperienceFirst：体验优先，CPU占用上限默认为15%
parameters.name: performance_mode

parameters.help_en:
The action to take on high-risk virus files. Valid values:
Quarantine: Quarantine quarantined file.
Notify: Report an alert only without taking action on quarantined file
parameters.help_zh:
对高危病毒文件的处置动作。取值：
Quarantine：隔离文件。
Notify：仅上报告警，不处置文件
parameters.name: high_risk_operation

parameters.help_en:
The action to take on medium-risk virus files. Valid values:
Quarantine: Quarantine quarantined file.
Notify: Report an alert only without taking action on quarantined file
parameters.help_zh:
对中危病毒文件的处置动作。取值：
Quarantine：隔离文件。
Notify：仅上报告警，不处置文件
parameters.name: mid_risk_operation

parameters.help_en:
The action to take on low-risk virus files. Valid values:
Quarantine: Quarantine quarantined file.
Notify: Report an alert only without taking action on quarantined file.
None: Take no action
parameters.help_zh:
对低危病毒文件的处置动作。取值：
Quarantine：隔离文件。
Notify：仅上报告警，不处置文件。
None：不处理
parameters.name: low_risk_operation

parameters.help_en:
The matching mode for the effective scope. Valid values:
UserGroupAll: The policy takes effect for all users under the current Alibaba Cloud account.
UserGroupNormal: The policy takes effect only for users in specified user groups. UserGroupIds is required when this value is specified
parameters.help_zh:
生效范围的匹配方式。取值：
UserGroupAll：对当前阿里云账号下的全部用户生效。
UserGroupNormal：仅对指定用户组内的用户生效，此时UserGroupIds必填
parameters.name: match_mode

parameters.help_en: The exception user list. Users in this list are excluded from the scan performed by this policy. A maximum of 1000 entries can be specified, and duplicates are not allowed. This parameter performs a full overwrite, meaning the provided list replaces the existing list of the policy
parameters.help_zh: 例外用户名单，名单内的用户不执行该策略的扫描。最多包含1000个，不允许重复。本参数为全量覆盖，传入的名单会替换该策略原有的名单
parameters.name: whitelist

parameters.help_en: The collection of user group IDs for the effective scope. At least 1 and at most 100 IDs can be specified, and duplicates are not allowed. When the effective scope is UserGroupNormal, the provided collection fully replaces the existing user groups of the policy. When the effective scope is UserGroupAll and the effective scope is not being modified, this parameter must not be specified
parameters.help_zh: 生效的用户组ID集合。至少包含1个，最多包含100个，不允许重复。生效范围为UserGroupNormal时，传入的集合会全量替换该策略原有的用户组。生效范围为UserGroupAll且本次不修改生效范围时，不允许传入
parameters.name: user_group_ids

parameters.help_en:
The unit of the trigger cycle. Valid values:
day: by day.
week: by week
parameters.help_zh:
触发周期的单位。取值：
day：按天。
week：按周
parameters.name: scan_frequency

parameters.help_en: The interval number of the trigger cycle, which together with ScanFrequency determines the trigger cycle. Valid values: 1 to 30. For example, if ScanFrequency is set to week and ScanInterval is set to 1, the scan is triggered once a week
parameters.help_zh: 触发周期的间隔数，与ScanFrequency共同决定触发周期。取值范围：1~30。例如ScanFrequency取值为week、ScanInterval取值为1时，表示每周扫描一次
parameters.name: scan_interval

parameters.help_en: The start hour during which scans can be triggered. The value is a whole hour number. Valid values: 0 to 23, inclusive. This field is not a timestamp
parameters.help_zh: 允许触发扫描的起始小时，取整点小时数，取值范围：0~23，包含该小时。本字段不是时间戳
parameters.name: scan_begin_time

parameters.help_en: The end hour during which scans can be triggered. The value is a whole hour number. Valid values: 1 to 24, exclusive of the specified hour, and must be greater than ScanBeginTime. Scan tasks generated by each trigger expire at this hour on the same day. This field is not a timestamp
parameters.help_zh: 允许触发扫描的结束小时，取整点小时数，取值范围：1~24，不包含该小时，且必须大于ScanBeginTime。每次触发生成的扫描任务在当天该整点失效。本字段不是时间戳
parameters.name: scan_end_time

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the scheduled virus scan policy to modify. You can obtain the value from:
[ListVirusScanScheduledStrategies](~~ListVirusScanScheduledStrategies~~): Lists scheduled virus scan policies.
[CreateVirusScanScheduledStrategy](~~CreateVirusScanScheduledStrategy~~): Creates a scheduled virus scan policy
parameters.help_zh:
待修改的病毒定时扫描策略ID。取值来源：
[ListVirusScanScheduledStrategies](~~ListVirusScanScheduledStrategies~~)：批量查询病毒定时扫描策略。
[CreateVirusScanScheduledStrategy](~~CreateVirusScanScheduledStrategy~~)：创建病毒定时扫描策略
parameters.name: strategy_id

parameters.help_en: The maximum percentage of terminal CPU usage allowed during scanning. Valid values: 0 to 100
parameters.help_zh: 扫描时占用终端CPU的百分比上限。取值范围：0~100
parameters.name: max_cpu_usage
